# tanstack-table Table of Contents

TanStack Table `@tanstack/react-table@9.0.0` (stable v9 release). This is a major rewrite from v8: the API surface, feature registration model, and docs layout all changed. Do not assume v8 conventions (`api/`, `introduction.md`, `faq.md`) apply here.

## Directory Map

```
contents/
├── agent-skills.md              # Wiring TanStack Intent / Agent Skills into AI coding tools
├── devtools.md                  # TanStack Devtools adapter for Table
├── installation.md              # Package install per framework
├── overview.md                  # Top-level overview + v8→v9 migration pointers per framework
├── guide/                       # Core, framework-agnostic concept guides (14 files)
├── framework/
│   ├── react/                   # React adapter (90 files)
│   │   ├── quick-start.md
│   │   ├── guide/               # React feature guides: sorting, filtering, pagination, grouping,
│   │   │                        # selection, virtualization, migration, etc. (26 files)
│   │   └── reference/           # React-specific API reference (63 files)
│   │       ├── index/           # useTable, flexRender, createTableHook, table context (36 files)
│   │       └── legacy/          # useLegacyTable compat layer types/functions (26 files)
│   └── vanilla/                 # Vanilla JS/TS adapter (4 files)
│       ├── quick-start.md
│       └── guide/               # aggregation.md, flex-render.md, table-state.md (3 files)
└── reference/                   # Auto-generated core API reference (688 files, ~58 lines/file)
    ├── index.md
    ├── index/
    │   ├── interfaces/          # Type interfaces, e.g. Table, Column, Row, Cell, Header (198 files)
    │   ├── type-aliases/        # Type aliases, e.g. ColumnDef, RowData, AccessorFn (96 files)
    │   ├── variables/           # Feature registrations + built-in fns (sortFn_*, filterFn_*,
    │   │                        # aggregationFn_*, {feature}Feature) (68 files)
    │   └── functions/           # Core standalone functions, e.g. createTable, createColumnHelper (39 files)
    └── static-functions/
        └── functions/           # Per-entity instance methods, named `{entity}_{method}.md`
                                  # e.g. column_getIsSorted, row_getIsSelected, table_getState (284 files)
```

Note: this config's `_source.exclude` drops 10 redundant framework adapters (alpine, angular,
ember, lit, octane, preact, qwik, solid, svelte, vue) — only `react` and `vanilla` are kept.

## Key Entry Points

| Task | Start Here |
|------|------------|
| New user, any framework | `contents/installation.md`, `contents/overview.md` |
| React quick start | `contents/framework/react/quick-start.md` |
| Vanilla JS/TS quick start | `contents/framework/vanilla/quick-start.md` |
| Understand `features` option (required in v9) | `contents/guide/features.md` |
| Table instance / core concepts | `contents/guide/tables.md`, `contents/guide/columns.md`, `contents/guide/rows.md` |
| Look up a type/interface by name | `contents/reference/index/interfaces/{Name}.md` or `type-aliases/{Name}.md` |
| Look up an instance method by name | `contents/reference/static-functions/functions/{entity}_{method}.md` |
| Migrating from v8 | `contents/framework/react/guide/migrating.md`, `contents/overview.md` |

## Detailed Structure

### guide/ (14 files) — framework-agnostic core concepts

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `tables.md` | The table instance: creation, adapters (`useTable`, `createTable`, etc.) |
| `columns.md` | Column objects generated by the table instance |
| `column-defs.md` | Setting up column definitions (accessor/display/group columns) |
| `rows.md` | Row objects: retrieving and interacting with rows |
| `cells.md` | Cell objects: retrieving and interacting with cells |
| `headers.md` | Header objects |
| `header-groups.md` | Header group objects |
| `row-models.md` | The row model pipeline (core, filtered, sorted, grouped, etc.) |
| `worker-row-models.md` | Experimental worker-thread row model plugin (100k+ rows) |
| `data.md` | Shaping your data for type-safe columns/rows |
| `features.md` | Why the `features` option is required in v9 and how to opt in |
| `helpers.md` | Type-inference helper functions (not behavioral) |
| `table-and-column-meta.md` | Attaching arbitrary `meta` to table/columns |
| `client-side-vs-server-side.md` | Client-side vs. server-side (manual) processing |

### framework/react/guide/ (26 files) — React feature guides

Per-feature guides, each paired with a `reference/index/variables/{feature}Feature.md` entry:
`sorting`, `column-filtering`, `global-filtering`, `fuzzy-filtering`, `column-faceting`,
`grouping`, `aggregation`, `pagination`, `expanding`, `column-ordering`, `column-pinning`,
`row-pinning`, `column-resizing`, `column-sizing`, `column-visibility`, `row-selection`,
`cell-selection`, `cell-spanning`, `virtualization`.

Plus React-specific mechanics: `flex-render.md`, `table-context.md`, `table-state.md`,
`composable-tables.md` (`createTableHook`), `custom-features.md`, `use-legacy-table.md`,
`migrating.md` (v8 → v9 migration).

### framework/react/reference/ (63 files)

| Subdir | Contents |
|--------|----------|
| `index/` (36) | `useTable`, `flexRender`, `createTableHook`, `createTableHookContexts`, `Subscribe`, table context prop/component types |
| `legacy/` (26) | Types and functions for the `useLegacyTable` incremental-migration compat layer |

### framework/vanilla/ (4 files)

`quick-start.md` + `guide/{aggregation,flex-render,table-state}.md`.

### reference/ (688 files) — auto-generated core API reference

One file per exported symbol from `@tanstack/table-core`, ~58 lines each (signature, source
link, description, params). Organized by symbol kind:

- `index/interfaces/` (198) — e.g. `Table.md`, `Column.md`, `Row.md`, `Cell.md`, `Header.md`,
  and per-feature context/options interfaces (`AggregationContext.md`, `Cell_CellSelection.md`, ...)
- `index/type-aliases/` (96) — e.g. `ColumnDef.md`, `RowData.md`, `AccessorFn.md`
- `index/variables/` (68) — feature registration objects (`{feature}Feature.md` — sorting,
  columnFiltering, globalFiltering, columnGrouping, rowPagination, rowExpanding, columnOrdering,
  columnPinning, columnResizing, columnSizing, columnVisibility, rowPinning, rowSelection,
  cellSelection, cellSpanning) and built-in fn implementations (`sortFn_*`, `filterFn_*`,
  `aggregationFn_*`)
- `index/functions/` (39) — standalone functions like `createTable`, `createColumnHelper`,
  `assignPrototypeAPIs`
- `static-functions/functions/` (284) — instance methods, filename = `{entity}_{method}.md`
  (`cell_*`, `column_*`, `row_*`, `table_*`, `header_*`), e.g. `column_getIsSorted.md`,
  `row_getIsSelected.md`, `table_getState.md`

To find a specific API: grep the reference tree by symbol name, or use the Topic Guide in
SKILL.md to jump to the right feature area first, then look for `{feature}Feature.md` (behavior)
and `{entity}_{method}.md` (per-entity methods) under `reference/`.

### root files (4)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `installation.md` | Per-framework package install commands |
| `overview.md` | High-level overview; links to per-framework v8→v9 migration guides |
| `devtools.md` | TanStack Devtools adapter for inspecting table state |
| `agent-skills.md` | Wiring TanStack Table's bundled Agent Skills (TanStack Intent) into AI coding tools |
